questions.stem: Why does __slots__ reduce memory for an astronomer's many Star instances?

options.text: It removes __dict__ and stores attributes in fixed slots

questions.explanation: Slots eliminates per-instance __dict__, storing attributes in a compact fixed layout. This saves memory for many instances.
questions.hint: No per-instance dictionary.

questions.stem: Why is a bare except: discouraged in an astronomer's code?

options.text: It is syntax invalid in Python 3

questions.hint: It is too broad.
